title: axum-core extraction contracts
summary:
Implements reusable request extraction traits, state projection, body limits, tuple extraction, and rejection types.

Agent mapper reason: These files jointly define the reusable extractor API and the rules for consuming request data.

ownedFiles.reason: Provides the default request-body limit policy.
Defines state projection from a larger state value.
Defines and exposes the core extractor contracts.
Supports composing multiple extractors as tuples.

contextFiles.reason: Declares crate dependencies and feature gates.
Shows how the main crate builds on core extraction contracts.
Generates implementations of related extraction contracts.
